primary_endpoint: Plasma AOC3 activity relative to baseline after 12 weeks of treatment (Day 85).
efficacy_outcome: At Day 85, plasma AOC3 activity relative to baseline was 102% with placebo and 24.0%, 13.1%, 8.27%, and 2.06% with BI 1467335 1, 3, 6, and 10 mg, respectively; no statistical comparisons were reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 1/32 placebo recipients and 2/81 BI 1467335 recipients; no deaths were reported.
